reports.title: Reports
reports.intro: Room performance, bookings made, and cancellations and no-shows for the period you choose, compared with the same dates last year.
reports.basis: Room revenue = nights price after discount, without tax and service, counted on the night stayed. Extras (late check-out/early check-in fees) are shown apart. Available nights = active villas × nights, minus maintenance nights.
reports.greyIsLastYear: Grey figures underneath: the same dates last year.
reports.madeIntro: Bookings made in this period (booking date), including those cancelled later. Holds that were never paid are not counted.
reports.noBookings: No bookings were made in this period.
reports.lostIntro: Cancellations of confirmed bookings by cancellation date; no-shows by arrival date.
reports.ratesNote: Cancellation rate = cancellations ÷ bookings made in the same period. No-show rate = no-shows ÷ arrivals due in this period.
reports.paceIntro: Nights and room revenue already booked for the coming months, compared with the same point last year, and how much was added this week.
reports.paceAsOf: Position today ({today}) for stay dates up to {to}, compared with the position on {lyToday} for the dates a year earlier. Pickup = change over the last {days} days.
reports.paceBasis: Counted on the books: bookings made by that date, ever confirmed, and not yet cancelled then. Room revenue after discount, without tax and service.
reports.lyFinalNote: Last year final result for the same months: {revenue}, {nights} nights, occupancy {occupancy}. The gap is what is still to win.
reports.otbOccupancyByMonth: Occupancy on the books by month
reports.otbRevenueByMonth: Room revenue on the books by month
reports.paceLimit: Note: bookings whose dates changed are counted on their current dates and price; available nights use the current villa status.
